thread:
ashley: Heads-up: we need to pick a final shape for internal APIs before the next release. Options: gRPC-only internal w/ thin JSON adapter at edge OR JSON-first gateway with transcoding. I put a short note here: https://go/redwood/rfcs/gateway-shape. Open to quick takes.

mike: +1 for gRPC-internal. Less ambiguity in contracts, cheaper for inter-service calls. Adapter at edge for browsers.

rita: Ops caution: adapters add a place where quota attribution can go wrong. We need explicit headers carrying route+tenant+adapter-version so Console shows per-route usage. Suggest headers: `x-rw-route`, `x-rw-tenant`, `x-rw-adapter`.

jonathan: Benchmarks from the PoC: the transcoding layer added ~30% p95 on 512-token calls in our sim. Also metering ended up attributed to gateway not runtime which broke per-model cost dashboards.

ashley: Proposal: hybrid = gRPC internal + auto-generated thin JSON adapter (no business logic). Adapter should only validate/marshal/proxy; rate-limit decisions are centralized (either adapter or runtime) to avoid split-brain.

mike: Implementation note: we can autogen adapters from proto using `protoc --json_out` + a tiny runtime shim. Streaming is hairy (proto streams -> SSE/ws). Need tests.

rita: Centralization requirement: quota enforcement must be single-source. Recommend runtime as enforcement point and adapter only forwards metadata. If adapter rejects (schema error) it must emit `x-rw-drop-reason: schema_error` and `x-rw-fallback: false`. If runtime rejects: `x-rw-drop-reason: rate_limit|overload`.

ashley: Rollout UX: per-route config `use_adapter: true|false`, `adapter_version: v1`. Canary by tenant tag (10%) + route-level canary. Console should have adapter card showing adoption %, fallback rate, and p95 latency.

jonathan: Circuit-breaker: if adapter latency or error rate rises, should we fail open to legacy path or fail closed? I vote fail-closed by default to avoid silent correctness regressions. Only fail-open after explicit verification that fallback is safe. Dashboard alert if fallback_rate > 1%.

ashley: ops/deploy note: deploy-bot scheduled canary for gateway/adapter v1 -> 2025-07-18T15:00Z; group `beta-adapter`.

mike: CI: add contract tests `ci/gateway-adapter/roundtrip` that assert proto<->json roundtrip and correct quota emission headers. Nightly run.

rita: Console mapping: map `x-rw-tenant` -> tenant filter, `x-rw-route` -> route view, `x-rw-drop-reason` -> reason column for requests. Also store `adapter_version` in telemetry to track rollouts.

ashley: Action items: mike adds CI + streaming adapter tests; rita formalizes header set + Console mappings; jonathan builds adapter adoption card + alert; i'll draft RFC + minimal proto->json autogen proposal. I'll open RFC tomorrow if no objections. Please +1 or comment by EOD.

mike: +1 from me, will schedule the CI job.

rita: +1. Will paste header spec in ops-docs and sync with security on header leakage concerns.

jonathan: +1. I'll prototype dashboard widgets and wire alerts.

ashley: Thanks everyone. If we hit no blockers I'll schedule a 30m sync after RFC. :raised_hands:
